svg.title: Indeed charge a nonzero term to all marker pins in its support. At least one is present. Since eecB(Si) ≥1, summing the sitewise bound over the |V | pins dominates the desired sum. The scope and positive degree conditions ensure the required pin is present. For the unmarked background profiles the same argument charges to all sites, giving P q ∥bq(U)∥w ≤|Λ|u, where u is their sitewise activity budget. Suppose also
